scope: Independent frozen High DAY scenery quarter only; visual pixels and approved visual requirements. No catalogue rescore or source/provenance conclusion.

overall_day_quarter.reason: All twelve destinations remain below full appearance acceptance. The clearest contact blocker is the raised Realm Gate threshold/tower bases. Coarse stone, broad uniform turf, abrupt ground/paving discontinuities and heavy world-obscuring HUD remain visible despite readable landmark silhouettes and cliff depth.

inspection_coverage.contexts: Four supplied Day views (approach/gameplay/reverse/detail) in clear and rain at each destination. Contact review is not a claim that all 96 originals were opened.
inspection_coverage.matching_before_after: No new before/after comparison asserted; this quarter was judged directly against approved references/bar. Earlier evidence files remain preserved.

bar_A.reason: Material finish, ground integration and prop appeal do not reach approved coherent reference presentation.

static_day_sky_weather_depth.reason: Cool sky, cloud deck, separated cliff layers and darker/more obscured rain distance are visibly readable. Near trainer/ground remain legible in selected clear/rain originals. This bounded result does not certify complete Bar B atmosphere, temporal variation or shafts/motion.

HUD_world_readability.reason: Large MAIN STORY objective box and minimap cover significant world area, including bridge span and architecture; smaller scene text is not consistently readable. Prompts and trainer remain readable in the selected stills.

day_landmark_and_settlement_identity.reason: Visible bells/bridge, arch, gate, shrine reverse, perches, Aviary and inhabited camp/settlement shapes are distinguishable. This applies only to headings actually showing those subjects; off-heading contexts are named below.
limits: Cliffhold approach is interior, not exterior arrival.
Sky Shrine forward views look outward; reverse reveals shrine.

high_perch_camera_entire_requirement.reason: Immediate court and trainer read in supplied Day views. These stills do not supply landing/departure transition, continuous height change, or all required camera contexts. Existing camera findings remain preserved.

literal_no_float_clip_entire_requirement.reason: This Day quarter contains a visible Gate contact failure and unverified distant attachment; no whole no-float/clipping pass. No claim about other quarters or unseen bodies/poses.

destinations.reason: Gate arch, cyan lamps and narrow approach read clearly; forward full views show threshold/tower bases suspended above the green approach. Brown cliff and moss-green masonry remain coarse.
